item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Chicken in tartlets, tender chicken with asparagus served in warm tartlets and topped with tomato and parsley. Served with a pointed cabbage salad with hazelnuts and pear tossed in lemon and cold-pressed rapeseed oil. Also available gluten free in a crispy tortilla bowl. (1+2+6+9)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Gyros pork neck bowl, Greek gyros-marinated roasted pork neck tossed with vegetables, served on roasted oregano potatoes and topped with parsley. Served with tzatziki, Greek salad and lemon. The dish is gluten free. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Gyros soy protein bowl, Greek gyros-marinated roasted soy protein tossed with vegetables, served on roasted oregano potatoes and topped with parsley. Served with tzatziki, Greek salad and lemon. The dish is gluten free. (6+7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Braised lamb shoulder with potato gratin, sugared berries and the braising jus. (6+10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Stuffed portobello mushrooms with potato gratin, sugared berries and a creamy mushroom sauce. (6+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Pad krapow, the Thai classic with flavourful, spicy pork. Served with rice and a fried egg. (2+3+4+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: pad krapow. Served with rice and a fried egg. (2+3+4+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Italian beef lasagne, topped with warm, creamy vodka sauce, parmesan and parsley. Served with chilli sauce and an Italian chopped salad with red wine vinaigrette. Also available gluten free and dairy free. (1+2+6+10+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Italian pea protein lasagne, topped with warm, creamy vodka sauce, parmesan and parsley. Served with chilli sauce and an Italian chopped salad with red wine vinaigrette. Also available gluten free and dairy free (vegan). (1+2+6+10+13+15)
